title: SKE Crystal 2400 4in1 Watermelon Strawberry Pre-Filled Vape Pods 20mg - 4 x Pods
description: Dive into a refreshing blend of Watermelon and Strawberry in these SKE Crystal 4in1 prefilled pods. The combination of fresh, juicy watermelon and sweet, succulent strawberries creates a delightful MTL vaping experience, with Nic-Salt vape juice providing a smooth, flavourful hit with each inhalation. The SKE Crystal 4in1 Vape Pods replicate the popular flavours of SKE Crystal Disposable Vapes in a more cost-effective and eco-friendly format. Designed for the SKE Crystal 4in1 Prefilled Pod Kits, these easy-to-use pods fit seamlessly into the device's rotating mechanism, allowing you to enjoy four flavours in one handy vape kit.
